title: Avrocar as cover for Roswell craft work and Nazi scientist recruitment

plain: The Avrocar, a saucer-shaped experimental aircraft built in Canada, was probably a cover for deeper work on the craft said to have crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947, along with the recruiting of Nazi scientists. Michels offers this as his own theory, resting it on rumors that the Roswell craft was taken to Wright Field, an Air Force base in Ohio. If he is right, a public aircraft project would have hidden study of a recovered craft.
